crownPassive.name: Stony gaze
crownPassive.text: An enemy hero that hits Medusa with a melee attack loses 1 Speed for the rest of the fight. Each hero can only be slowed this way once.

bond.name: Gorgon sisters
bond.text: +1 Guard for each of your Hellas heroes that has died.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Serpent hair
actions.text: Two random enemy cards each gain 2 Poison.

actions.name: Petrify
actions.text: An enemy hero takes no actions this round. Like every stopping effect, it can't stop the same hero two rounds running. Once per fight.
